articles.title_en: Heteroskedastic supply and demand estimation: Analysis and testing
articles.title_cn: 异方差供给与需求估计：分析与检验
articles.abstract_en: The Feenstra (1994) method is widely used in the international trade literature to estimate supply and demand elasticities. The method is mechanically an IV strategy, and we demonstrate that this has important implications for its application and reliability. The assumptions needed for it to yield unbiased estimates are stronger than previously understood, and in practice, estimates are subject to bias due to both weak instruments and violations of the exclusion restriction. We illustrate how these arise in context and show that standard tests identify estimates that are likely to be biased. In an application to U.S. import data, estimates of import demand and export supply elasticities are substantially lower among goods that pass standard tests relative to those that fail. We find evidence that this difference in elasticities reflects reduction of bias as well as some selection in the set of goods that tend to pass both tests.
articles.abstract_cn: Feenstra（1994）方法在国际贸易文献中被广泛用于估计供给和需求弹性。该方法在机制上是一种工具变量策略，我们证明这对它的应用和可靠性具有重要含义。使其产生无偏估计所需的假设比之前理解的更强，在实践中，估计会因弱工具变量和排他性约束的违反而受到偏误。我们阐述了这些情况如何在具体情境中出现，并表明标准检验能够识别出可能偏误的估计。在对美国进口数据的应用中，通过标准检验的商品其进口需求和出口供给弹性的估计值显著低于未通过检验的商品。我们发现证据表明，这种弹性差异既反映了偏误的减少，也反映了在倾向于通过两项检验的商品集合中存在一定的选择性。

articles.title_en: Sovereign debt crises and low interest rates
articles.title_cn: 主权债务危机与低利率
articles.abstract_en: We revisit the occurrence of self-fulfilling crises in sovereign debt markets under time-varying interest rates and growth in Eaton and Gersovitz (1981)’s model. We show that, when long-term interest rates exceed growth, insolvency is solely caused by the exhaustion of the sovereign’s debt repayment capacity subject to limited commitment. Indeed, high interest rates impose discipline on market sentiments, because creditors necessarily become more optimistic about solvency when the sovereign reduces debt exposure. Creditors’ beliefs respond instead ambiguously under low interest rates fluctuating around growth. As long as interest rates exceed growth, debt reduction alleviates the fiscal burden. However, the sovereign also benefits from the prospect of rolling over outstanding debt as long as interest rates remain below growth. Thus, creditors’ sentiments might adjust adversely to fiscal consolidation. When the default punishment is not disproportionately severe, this mechanism sustains belief-driven debt crises even when fundamentals would otherwise ensure solvency.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们重新审视了在Eaton和Gersovitz（1981）模型中，利率和增长随时间变化时主权债务市场中自我实现危机的发生。我们表明，当长期利率超过增长时，无偿付能力仅由主权债务偿还能力的耗尽引起，且受有限承诺约束。实际上，高利率对市场情绪施加纪律，因为当主权国家减少债务敞口时，债权人必然对偿付能力更加乐观。相反，在围绕增长波动的低利率下，债权人的信念反应模糊。只要利率超过增长，债务减少就能减轻财政负担。然而，只要利率保持在增长之下，主权国家也能从展期未偿债务的前景中受益。因此，债权人的情绪可能对财政整顿产生不利调整。当违约惩罚并非不成比例地严重时，即使基本面本可确保偿付能力，这一机制也能维持由信念驱动的债务危机。

articles.title_en: Opening up in the 21st century: A quantitative accounting of Chinese export growth
articles.title_cn: 21世纪开放：中国出口增长的量化核算
articles.abstract_en: China’s rapid export growth has spurred extensive research investigating its effects on other economies. The exact causes of the boom as well as the slowdown in Chinese exporting after 2007 are less well-understood. We quantify the drivers of Chinese export growth using a general equilibrium model estimated with detailed trade and production data that capture rich heterogeneity across destinations, firm ownership types, production locations, and sectors. We find that the three key drivers of Chinese export growth overall are rising foreign demand, improvements in access to imported intermediates, and factor productivity growth within China. Weakening foreign demand and a lack of further improvements in imported inputs access largely explain the slowdown in exporting after 2007. Furthermore, important differences especially across sectors and firms of different ownership types caution against any single narrative.
articles.abstract_cn: 中国出口的快速增长引发了对其对其他经济体影响的广泛研究。但对中国出口繁荣及2007年后放缓的确切原因了解较少。我们使用一个通过详细贸易和生产数据估计的一般均衡模型来量化中国出口增长的驱动因素，这些数据捕捉了目的地、企业所有权类型、生产地点和部门之间的丰富异质性。我们发现，中国出口增长的三个关键驱动因素总体上是外国需求上升、进口中间品获取改善以及中国国内要素生产率增长。外国需求减弱和进口投入品获取缺乏进一步改善在很大程度上解释了2007年后出口放缓的原因。此外，特别是不同部门和不同所有权类型企业之间的重要差异提醒我们不要采用任何单一解释。

articles.title_en: Capital controls and firm performance
articles.title_cn: 资本管制与企业绩效
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the differential effects of capital controls (CCs) on firms’ performance depending on the firm’s production technology and export status. We empirically characterize the firm’s responses to the introduction of a CC using the Chilean encaje implemented between 1991 and 1998. Motivated by the empirical insights, we build a general equilibrium model with heterogeneous firms, financial constraints and international trade and calibrate it to the Chilean economy. We find that CCs have heterogeneous effects on firms. Exporting firms operating in more capital-intensive sectors are more negatively affected than exporting firms operating in less capital-intensive sectors. Non-exporting firms in capital-intensive sectors experience more negative effects on capital than firms in less-capital intensive sectors, but the opposite is true for domestic sales. These results are a consequence of the increase in financing costs, the depreciation of the real exchange rate, and compositional effects on the mass of exporters and non-exporters.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了资本管制（CCs）对企业绩效的差异化影响，这种影响取决于企业的生产技术及出口状态。我们利用智利在1991至1998年间实施的encaje政策，实证刻画了企业对引入资本管制的反应。基于实证洞察，我们构建了一个包含异质性企业、金融约束和国际贸易的一般均衡模型，并将其校准至智利经济。我们发现资本管制对企业具有异质性影响。在资本更密集型行业运营的出口企业，其受到的负面影响大于在资本密集度较低行业运营的出口企业。资本密集型行业中的非出口企业在资本方面受到的负面影响大于资本密集度较低行业中的企业，但国内销售方面则相反。这些结果是融资成本上升、实际汇率贬值以及出口商和非出口商数量构成效应共同作用的结果。

articles.title_en: A theory of economic sanctions as terms-of-trade manipulation
articles.title_cn: 经济制裁作为贸易条件操纵的理论
articles.abstract_en: How can a country design economic sanctions to maximize their economic cost to the sanctioned country at the lowest cost to the sanctioner? I consider this problem from the perspective of international trade and draw a close connection between trade restrictions as economic sanctions and trade restrictions as terms-of-trade manipulation. This connection has useful implications for the design of trade taxes as sanctions: Small sanctions increase welfare in the sanctioning country. Sanctions target the same goods as terms-of-trade manipulation. Sanctions ignore elasticities of demand and supply in the sanctioning country.
articles.abstract_cn: 一个国家如何设计经济制裁，以在对制裁国成本最低的情况下，最大化对被制裁国的经济成本？我从国际贸易的角度考虑这一问题，并将作为经济制裁的贸易限制与作为贸易条件操纵的贸易限制紧密联系起来。这种联系对设计作为制裁的贸易税具有有用的启示：小规模制裁会增加制裁国的福利。制裁针对的商品与贸易条件操纵相同。制裁忽略了制裁国国内的需求和供给弹性。

articles.title_en: Quantifying the Germany shock: Structural labor-market reforms and spillovers in a currency union
articles.title_cn: 量化德国冲击：货币联盟中的结构性劳动力市场改革与溢出效应
articles.abstract_en: We examine the effects of unilateral structural reforms within a currency union. Focusing on the surge of German competitiveness following the introduction of the Euro, we first provide reduced-form causal evidence supporting the notion that German structural labor-market reforms in the early 2000s led to a crowding-out of manufacturing employment in other Eurozone economies. To assess the impact of this German competitiveness shock, we build a quantitative multi-sector trade model that features downward nominal wage rigidities, endogenous labor supply, unemployment-insurance benefits and international savings. The fixed nominal exchange rate can create binding nominal rigidities in response to a foreign real supply shock – like the one prompted by the German reforms – resulting in significant contraction of manufacturing sectors and increased involuntary unemployment across other Eurozone countries. We consider a number of counterfactual scenarios, such as the impact of German labor-market reforms in the absence of a fixed exchange-rate regime, the role of coordinated reforms within the Eurozone and a higher average inflation rate.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了货币联盟内单边结构性改革的影响。聚焦于欧元引入后德国竞争力的激增，我们首先提供了简化形式的因果证据，支持德国在2000年代初期的结构性劳动力市场改革导致了欧元区其他经济体制造业就业被挤出的观点。为了评估这一德国竞争力冲击的影响，我们构建了一个定量多部门贸易模型，该模型具有名义工资刚性、内生劳动力供给、失业保险福利和国际储蓄的特征。固定名义汇率可能应对外国实际供给冲击（如德国改革所引发的冲击）而产生约束性名义刚性，导致欧元区其他国家制造业部门显著收缩和非自愿失业增加。我们考虑了一系列反事实情景，例如在没有固定汇率制度的情况下德国劳动力市场改革的影响、欧元区内协调改革的作用以及更高的平均通胀率。

articles.title_en: Sovereign debt and economic growth when government is myopic and self-interested
articles.title_cn: 当政府短视且自利时的主权债务与经济增长
articles.abstract_en: We examine how a sovereign’s ability to borrow abroad affects the country’s growth and steady-state consumption when the government is both myopic and self-interested. Surprisingly, government myopia can increase a country’s access to external borrowing and extend the government’s effective horizon, giving it a stake in incentivizing private production and savings despite its self-interest. In a high-saving country, the lengthening of the government’s effective horizon can incentivize it to tax less, resulting in a “growth boost”, with higher steady-state household consumption than if it could not borrow abroad. However, in a country that saves little, the government may engage in repressive tax policies to channel domestic savings into government bonds. This increases future governments’ costs of default, and in turn enhances current debt capacity and spending, but can lead to a “growth trap” where steady-state household consumption is lower than without government’s access to external borrowing.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了当政府既短视又自利时，主权国家在国外借款的能力如何影响该国的增长和稳态消费。令人惊讶的是，政府短视可以增加一个国家获得外部借款的渠道，并延长政府的有效视野，使其尽管自利，却有动力激励私人生产和储蓄。在高储蓄国家，政府有效视野的延长可以激励其减少征税，从而产生“增长提振”，使稳态家庭消费高于其无法在国外借款的情况。然而，在储蓄较少的国家，政府可能采取压制性税收政策，将国内储蓄引导至政府债券。这增加了未来政府的违约成本，进而增强了当前的债务能力和支出，但可能导致“增长陷阱”，即稳态家庭消费低于政府无法获得外部借款的情况。

articles.title_en: Firm input choice under trade policy uncertainty
articles.title_cn: 贸易政策不确定性下的企业投入选择
articles.abstract_en: We examine the role of trade policy uncertainty (TPU) in shaping the import decisions of firms. In a model where firms must incur sunk costs to adopt new imported varieties of an input, a reduction in TPU for a given input increases imports of that input (a substitution effect) and possibly other inputs (a scale effect). We explore this in the context of China’s accession to the WTO, which bound China’s tariffs. We find that, controlling for current tariffs, the threat of reversion to past high tariffs reduces imports, but much less so after WTO accession, consistent with lower TPU. The current-tariff trade elasticity also increases after WTO entry, reflecting a greater perceived permanence of current tariffs. We find evidence of both substitution and scale effects for imports, and post accession, firms were more likely to adopt products previously subject to higher tariff risk.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了贸易政策不确定性（TPU）在塑造企业进口决策中的作用。在一个模型中，企业必须承担沉没成本才能采用新的进口投入品种，某一给定投入的TPU降低会增加该投入的进口（替代效应），并可能增加其他投入的进口（规模效应）。我们在中国加入WTO的背景下探讨这一点，这约束了中国的关税。我们发现，在控制当前关税的情况下，恢复到过去高关税的威胁会减少进口，但在加入WTO后这种影响要小得多，这与较低的TPU一致。当前关税的贸易弹性在加入WTO后也有所增加，反映出当前关税被认为更具持久性。我们发现了进口的替代效应和规模效应的证据，并且在加入WTO后，企业更有可能采用以前面临较高关税风险的产品。

articles.title_en: Accounting for trade patterns
articles.title_cn: 解释贸易模式
articles.abstract_en: We develop a quantitative framework for decomposing trade patterns. We derive price indexes that determine comparative advantage and the aggregate cost of living. If firms and products are imperfect substitutes, we show that these price indexes depend on variety, average appeal (including quality), and the dispersion of appeal-adjusted prices. We show that they are only weakly related to standard empirical measures of average prices. We find that 40 percent of the cross-section variation in comparative advantage, and 90 percent of the time-series variation, is accounted for by variety and average appeal, with less than 10 percent attributed to average prices.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个用于分解贸易模式的定量框架。我们推导出决定比较优势和总体生活成本的价格指数。如果企业和产品是不完全替代的，我们表明这些价格指数取决于品种、平均吸引力（包括质量）以及吸引力调整后价格的离散度。我们表明它们与标准的平均价格实证度量只有微弱的相关性。我们发现，比较优势截面变异的40%和时间序列变异的90%由品种和平均吸引力解释，而平均价格所解释的部分不到10%。

articles.title_en: The Laffer curve for rules of origin
articles.title_cn: 原产地规则的拉弗曲线
articles.abstract_en: Firms in regional trade areas choose whether to comply with rules of origin (RoO) or pay a tariff penalty. Stricter content requirements initially expand regional part sourcing, but contract it when set at levels above a threshold, analogously to the Laffer curve for taxes. We calibrate the model to fit part cost shares for autos sold in North America. The effects of the 75% RoO imposed in 2020 depend on the relevant tariff and the ability to relocate assembly. With fixed assembly locations, the higher RoO reduces employment in all three countries for cars, where tariffs are low. For trucks, the 25% US tariff induces more compliance in Canada and Mexico, increasing employment in those countries. With the option to relocate assembly, higher RoOs redistribute employment to the US, but Canada and Mexico lose more, leading to a half percent decline in North American employment for both cars and trucks.
articles.abstract_cn: 区域贸易区内的企业选择遵守原产地规则（RoO）或支付关税罚款。更严格的内容要求最初会扩大区域零部件采购，但当设定在高于阈值水平时则会收缩，类似于税收的拉弗曲线。我们校准模型以拟合北美销售的汽车零部件成本份额。2020年实施的75%原产地规则的效果取决于相关关税和重新安置组装的能力。在组装地点固定的情况下，较高的原产地规则降低了所有三个国家中关税较低的汽车的就业。对于卡车，25%的美国关税促使加拿大和墨西哥更多合规，增加了这些国家的就业。在可以选择重新安置组装的情况下，较高的原产地规则将就业重新分配到美国，但加拿大和墨西哥损失更多，导致北美汽车和卡车的就业下降半个百分点。

articles.title_en: The unequal effects of trade and automation across local labor markets
articles.title_cn: 贸易与自动化对地方劳动力市场的不平等影响
articles.abstract_en: We quantify the joint impact of the China shock and automation of labor, across US commuting zones (CZs) in the period 2000–2007. To this end, we employ a multi-sector gravity model of trade with Roy-Fréchet worker heterogeneity across sectors, where labor input can be automated. Automation and increased import competition from China are both sector-specific; they lead to contractions in a sector’s labor demand and a decline in relative income for CZs more specialized in that sector, amplified by a voluntary reduction in hours worked and an increase in frictional unemployment. The estimated model fits well with the aggregate performance of manufacturing subsectors and with the variation across CZs in changes in average income, the hourly wage, hours worked, the employment rate and employment in manufacturing. By itself, the China shock has stronger distributional effects than automation, but its impact on aggregate gains is less than a third of automation’s impact.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们量化了在2000-2007年期间，中国冲击和劳动力自动化对美国通勤区的联合影响。为此，我们采用了一个多部门重力贸易模型，其中包含罗伊-弗雷谢特工人跨部门异质性，且劳动力投入可以被自动化。自动化和来自中国的进口竞争加剧都是部门特定的；它们导致部门劳动力需求收缩，并使专门从事该部门的通勤区的相对收入下降，这种效应因自愿减少工作时间和摩擦性失业增加而被放大。估计模型与制造业子行业的总体表现以及通勤区在平均收入、小时工资、工作时间、就业率和制造业就业变化上的差异拟合良好。单独来看，中国冲击的分配效应强于自动化，但其对总体收益的影响不到自动化影响的三分之一。

articles.title_en: Unveiling the dance of commodity prices and the global financial cycle
articles.title_cn: 揭示大宗商品价格与全球金融周期的互动
articles.abstract_en: We examine the impact of commodity price changes on the business cycles and capital flows in emerging markets and developing economies (EMDEs), distinguishing between their role as a source of shock and as a channel of transmission of global shocks. Our findings reveal that surges in export prices, triggered by commodity price shocks, boost domestic GDP, an effect further amplified by the endogenous decline of country spreads. However, the effects on capital flows appear muted. Shifts in U.S. monetary policy and global risk appetite drive the global financial cycle in EMDEs. Eased global credit conditions, attributed to looser U.S. monetary policy or lower global risk appetite, lead to a rise in export prices, higher output, a decrease in government borrowing costs, and stimulate greater capital flows. The endogenous response of export prices amplifies the output effects of a more accommodative U.S. monetary policy while country spreads magnify the impact of shifts in global risk appetite.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了大宗商品价格变动对新兴市场和发展中经济体（EMDEs）商业周期和资本流动的影响，区分其作为冲击来源和全球冲击传导渠道的作用。我们的研究结果表明，由大宗商品价格冲击引发的出口价格飙升会提振国内GDP，而这一效应又因国家利差的内生性下降而进一步放大。然而，对资本流动的影响似乎较为温和。美国货币政策的变化和全球风险偏好的转变驱动着EMDEs的全球金融周期。宽松的全球信贷条件，归因于美国货币政策的放松或全球风险偏好的降低，会导致出口价格上升、产出增加、政府借贷成本下降，并刺激更大的资本流动。出口价格的内生反应放大了更为宽松的美国货币政策对产出的影响，而国家利差则放大了全球风险偏好转变的影响。

articles.title_en: Preemptive austerity with rollover risk
articles.title_cn: 预防性紧缩与展期风险
articles.abstract_en: By preemptive austerity, we mean a policy that increases taxes to deter potential rollover crises. The policy is so successful that the usual danger signal of a rollover crisis, a high yield on new bonds sold, does not show up, because the policy eliminates the danger. Mechanically, high taxes make the safe zone in the model – the set of sovereign debt levels for which the government prefers to repay its debt rather than default – larger. By announcing a high tax rate at the beginning of the period, the government ensures that tax revenue will be high enough to service sovereign debt becoming due, which deters panics by international lenders but is ex-post suboptimal. That is why, as it engages in preemptive austerity, the government continues to reduce the level of debt to a point where, at least asymptotically, high taxes are no longer necessary.
articles.abstract_cn: 所谓预防性紧缩，是指一种通过增税来阻止潜在展期危机的政策。该政策非常成功，以至于展期危机的通常危险信号——新发行债券的高收益率——并未出现，因为该政策消除了危险。从机制上讲，高税收使模型中的安全区域——即政府更倾向于偿还债务而非违约的主权债务水平集合——扩大。通过在期初宣布高税率，政府确保税收收入足以偿还到期的主权债务，这阻止了国际贷款人的恐慌，但事后却是次优的。这就是为什么在实施预防性紧缩时，政府会继续将债务水平降低到至少渐近意义上不再需要高税收的程度。

articles.title_en: On regional borrowing, default, and migration
articles.title_cn: 关于地方借贷、违约与迁移
articles.abstract_en: How do local government borrowing, default, and migration interact? We find in-migration results in excessive debt accumulation due to a key externality: Immigrants help repay previously-issued debt. In addition to providing direct IV evidence on this mechanism, we show cities are heavily indebted, near state-imposed borrowing limits, vulnerable to interest rate increases, and default even after periods of robust population and productivity growth. Our quantitative model reproduces these features of the data and reveals a bifurcation: in-migration strongly affects borrowing, but borrowing only weakly affects migration. The model predicts large interest rate declines in the Great Recession prevented a wave of municipal defaults.
articles.abstract_cn: 地方政府借贷、违约与迁移如何相互作用？我们发现，由于一个关键的外部性，迁入人口导致过度债务积累：移民帮助偿还先前发行的债务。除了为此机制提供直接的IV证据外，我们还表明，城市负债累累，接近国家规定的借贷限额，易受利率上升影响，甚至在人口和生产率强劲增长期之后也会违约。我们的定量模型再现了数据的这些特征，并揭示了一个分叉：迁入人口强烈影响借贷，但借贷仅微弱影响迁移。模型预测，大衰退期间利率的大幅下降阻止了一波市政违约潮。

articles.title_en: Banking regulation with risk of sovereign default
articles.title_cn: 主权违约风险下的银行业监管
articles.abstract_en: Banking regulation routinely designates domestic government debt as safe, even when this debt is risky. We show, in a parsimonious model, that this failure to recognize the riskiness of government debt induces domestic banks to “gamble” with depositors’ funds by purchasing risky government bonds and assets correlated with them. Sovereign defaults then result in banking crises; however, by permitting banks to gamble, the regulator lowers the government’s borrowing costs ex-ante. Thus, the government has an incentive to ignore the riskiness of the sovereign bonds. We derive a set of testable implications and present supporting empirical evidence from sovereign debt crises in Russia, Argentina, and the Eurozone.
articles.abstract_cn: 银行业监管通常将国内政府债务指定为安全资产，即使该债务存在风险。我们在一个简约模型中表明，这种未能识别政府债务风险的做法会诱导国内银行利用存款人资金进行“赌博”，购买有风险的政府债券及与其相关的资产。主权违约随后导致银行业危机；然而，通过允许银行赌博，监管者事前降低了政府的借贷成本。因此，政府有动机忽视主权债券的风险。我们推导出一系列可检验的推论，并提供了来自俄罗斯、阿根廷和欧元区主权债务危机的支持性经验证据。

articles.title_en: Sovereign risk and bank lending: Evidence from 1999 Turkish Earthquake
articles.title_cn: 主权风险与银行信贷：来自1999年土耳其地震的证据
articles.abstract_en: We use an exogenous fiscal shock to identify the transmission of government risk to bank lending due to banks holding government bonds. We illustrate with a theoretical model that for banks with higher exposure to government bonds, a higher sovereign default risk implies lower bank net worth and less lending. Our empirical estimates confirm the model’s predictions. The exogenous change in sovereign default risk of Turkish government debt as a result of the 1999 Earthquake impacted banks whose balance sheets were exposed more to government bonds. The resulting lower bank net worth translates into a lower credit supply. We rule out alternative explanations. Our estimates suggest this channel can explain half of the decline in bank lending following the earthquake. This underlines the importance of the bank balance-sheet channel in transmitting a higher sovereign default risk to reduced real economic activity.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用外生财政冲击来识别因银行持有政府债券而导致政府风险向银行信贷的传导。我们通过理论模型说明，对于政府债券敞口较高的银行，较高的主权违约风险意味着较低的银行净值与较少的信贷。我们的实证估计证实了模型的预测。1999年土耳其地震导致的土耳其政府债务主权违约风险的外生变化，影响了那些资产负债表对政府债券敞口较大的银行。由此导致的银行净值下降转化为信贷供给的减少。我们排除了其他替代解释。我们的估计表明，这一渠道可以解释地震后银行信贷下降的一半。这凸显了银行资产负债表渠道在将较高的主权违约风险传导至实体经济活动的减少中的重要性。

articles.title_en: Trade and technology adoption in distorted economies
articles.title_cn: 扭曲经济体中的贸易与技术采纳
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines how labor market imperfections distort firm-level technology choices and alter the gains from trade in developing countries. Motivated by evidence that firms using modern technologies are disproportionately exposed to labor market distortions, we introduce firm-level technology choices and labor market distortions into an otherwise standard quantitative trade model. We then provide formulas for the welfare and labor productivity gains from trade liberalization, highlighting the role of distortions and technology choice. Our quantitative analysis reveals that labor market distortions provide a possible explanation for the inefficiently low levels of modern technology adoption in developing countries. Moreover, labor market distortions erode one-third of the potential labor productivity gains from trade liberalization among low-income countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了劳动力市场不完善如何扭曲企业层面的技术选择，并改变发展中国家的贸易收益。基于使用现代技术的企业不成比例地暴露于劳动力市场扭曲的证据，我们将企业层面的技术选择和劳动力市场扭曲引入一个原本标准的量化贸易模型。然后，我们提供了贸易自由化带来的福利和劳动生产率收益的公式，强调了扭曲和技术选择的作用。我们的量化分析揭示，劳动力市场扭曲为发展中国家现代技术采纳水平低下的无效率提供了一种可能的解释。此外，在低收入国家中，劳动力市场扭曲侵蚀了贸易自由化潜在劳动生产率收益的三分之一。

articles.title_en: Specialization, market access and real income
articles.title_cn: 专业化、市场准入与实际收入
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the impact of external demand shocks on real income. We utilize a first order approximation to a wide class of small open economy models that feature sector-level gravity in trade flows, which allows us to measure foreign shocks and characterize their welfare impact in terms of reduced-form elasticities. We use machine learning techniques to group 4-digit manufacturing sectors into a smaller number of clusters, and show that the cluster-level elasticities of income with respect to foreign shocks can be estimated using high-dimensional statistical techniques. Foreign demand shocks in complex intermediate and capital goods have large positive impacts on real income, whereas impacts in other sectors are negligible. We show that the estimates imply that countries that specialize in these sectors enjoy greater gains from increased openness, and that (small) export subsidies to these sectors are welfare-improving. Finally, a calibrated multi-sector production and trade model with input–output linkages and external economies of scale can match the empirical estimates.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文估计了外部需求冲击对实际收入的影响。我们利用一类广泛的小型开放经济模型的一阶近似，这些模型具有部门层面的贸易流量引力特征，使我们能够衡量外国冲击，并以其简化形式的弹性来刻画其福利影响。我们使用机器学习技术将4位数制造业部门划分为较少数量的聚类，并表明收入相对于外国冲击的聚类层面弹性可以使用高维统计技术进行估计。复杂中间品和资本品的外国需求冲击对实际收入有较大的正向影响，而其他部门的影响则可以忽略不计。我们表明，这些估计意味着专门从事这些部门的国家从开放度提高中获益更多，并且对这些部门（小规模）的出口补贴能够改善福利。最后，一个具有投入产出关联和外部规模经济的校准多部门生产与贸易模型能够匹配实证估计结果。

articles.title_en: Institutional specialization
articles.title_cn: 制度专业化
articles.abstract_en: This paper presents a theory of institutional specialization in which some countries uphold the rule of law while others choose extractive institutions, even when countries are ex-ante identical. The driving force of specialization is that for incumbents in each country, the first steps to the rule of law have the greatest cost. Good institutions require sharing power and rents, but in places where power is already shared broadly, each power base or branch of government underpinning institutions is individually less important and thus receives lower rents. Countries with diametrically opposed institutions have a symbiotic relationship in the world equilibrium. The transition from sail to steam-powered vessels in 19th-century trade provides suggestive evidence supporting the theory.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种制度专业化理论，在该理论中，即使各国在事前完全相同，一些国家维护法治，而另一些国家则选择榨取性制度。专业化的驱动力在于，对每个国家的在位者而言，迈向法治的最初几步成本最高。良好的制度要求分享权力和租金，但在权力已经广泛共享的地方，支撑制度的每个权力基础或政府分支单独来看就不那么重要，因此获得的租金较低。具有截然相反制度的国家在世界均衡中形成共生关系。从帆船到蒸汽动力船舶在19世纪贸易中的转变提供了支持该理论的启发性证据。

articles.title_en: Illuminating the effects of the US-China tariff war on China’s economy
articles.title_cn: 揭示中美关税战对中国经济的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the impact of the US-China tariff war on China, using high-frequency night lights data and grid-level measures of tariff exposure. Exploiting within-grid variation over time and controlling extensively for grid-specific contemporaneous trends, we find that each one-percentage-point increase in exposure to the US tariffs was associated with a 0.59% reduction in night-time luminosity. This impact was highly skewed across locations: Grids with negligible direct exposure to the US tariffs accounted for 70% of China’s population. But the tail 2.5% of China’s population with the highest exposure saw an implied 2.52% (1.62%) decrease in income per capita (employment) relative to unaffected grids. These effects were moreover concentrated in locations with a high commuting openness. By contrast, we do not find significant effects from China’s retaliatory tariffs, and offer evidence of several channels through which the impact on imported inputs was mitigated. In a parallel analysis at the prefecture level, we confirm that the US tariffs had discernible negative aggregate consequences.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用高频夜间灯光数据和网格级别的关税暴露度指标，研究了中美关税战对中国的影响。通过利用网格内随时间的变化并广泛控制网格特定的同期趋势，我们发现，对美国关税暴露度每增加一个百分点，夜间灯光亮度相应减少0.59%。这种影响在不同地区间高度不均衡：对美国关税直接暴露度可忽略不计的网格覆盖了中国70%的人口。但暴露度最高的2.5%中国人口，其人均收入（就业）相对于未受影响的网格下降了2.52%（1.62%）。此外，这些影响集中在通勤开放度高的地区。相比之下，我们没有发现中国报复性关税的显著影响，并提供了几个渠道的证据，表明进口投入品受到的影响得到了缓解。在市级层面的平行分析中，我们确认美国关税产生了明显的负面总体后果。

articles.title_en: Imported intermediate goods and product innovation
articles.title_cn: 进口中间品与产品创新
articles.abstract_en: We build a structural model of multi-product firms to illustrate how access to foreign intermediate goods contributes to product innovation. We establish a stochastic dynamic model of firm evolution and allow firms to be heterogeneous in their efficiency levels. The model’s mechanism to capture the effects of importing intermediate goods is twofold: (i) importing these goods increases the revenue per each product introduced, and (ii) increases the likelihood of introducing new varieties using newly available inputs. We calibrate the model to firm-level data from India. The model successfully explains the heterogeneous innovation dynamics and statistical moments related to importing and product distribution. Counterfactual exercises further illustrate and quantify the mechanism between trade, innovation performance, and product growth. We find that the critical contribution of trade to growth and product innovation is mainly through access to new imported varieties rather than just the direct import cost.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个多产品企业的结构模型，以说明获得外国中间品如何促进产品创新。我们建立了一个企业演化的随机动态模型，并允许企业在效率水平上存在异质性。该模型捕捉进口中间品效应的机制有两方面：（i）进口这些产品增加了每种引入产品的收入，以及（ii）增加了利用新可用投入引入新品种的可能性。我们将模型校准到印度的企业层面数据。该模型成功解释了与进口和产品分布相关的异质性创新动态和统计矩。反事实实验进一步说明并量化了贸易、创新绩效和产品增长之间的机制。我们发现，贸易对增长和产品创新的关键贡献主要在于获得新的进口品种，而不仅仅是直接的进口成本。

articles.title_en: Learning by exporting: Evidence from patent citations in China
articles.title_cn: 出口中学习：来自中国专利引用的证据
articles.abstract_en: Using matched firm-level data on operations, trade, and patents in China, we empirically investigate the impact of exporting on firms’ innovation and learning from destinations. We first show that access to export markets improves both the quantity and quality of innovation. We then construct a measure of knowledge flows based on Chinese patent citation data and demonstrate that there are actual knowledge transfers from destination markets to exporting firms, which help firms improve their innovation. These findings support the learning-by-exporting effect. Moreover, we show that this learning effect remains significant and unchanged, even after controlling for the spillover effect of FDI. To investigate how the learning process occurs, we also explore whether the learning-by-exporting effect varies with different export products or export modes. We find that vertical linkages and direct exporting facilitate Chinese firms’ learning from destination markets. Finally, we show that the learning effect is particularly salient at the extensive margin compared to the intensive margin.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用中国匹配的企业层面运营、贸易和专利数据，我们实证研究了出口对企业创新及从目的地市场学习的影响。我们首先表明，进入出口市场提高了创新的数量和质量。然后，我们基于中国专利引用数据构建了一个知识流动的度量，并证明确实存在从目的地市场到出口企业的实际知识转移，这有助于企业改进其创新。这些发现支持了出口中学习效应。此外，我们表明，即使在控制了外商直接投资（FDI）的溢出效应之后，这种学习效应仍然显著且不变。为了探究学习过程如何发生，我们还探讨了出口中学习效应是否因不同的出口产品或出口模式而异。我们发现，垂直联系和直接出口促进了中国企业从目的地市场的学习。最后，我们表明，与集约边际相比，学习效应在扩展边际上尤为显著。

articles.title_en: The pro-competitive effects of trade agreements
articles.title_cn: 贸易协定的促进竞争效应
articles.abstract_en: How does trade policy affect competition? Using the universe of product exports by firms from eleven low and middle income countries, we document that tariff reductions under trade agreements have strong pro-competitive effects — they encourage entry and reduce the (tariff exclusive) price-cost markups of exporters. This finding, that markups fall with tariff cuts, contradicts a core prediction of standard oligopolistic competition models of trade. We extend a workhorse international pricing model of oligopolistic competition to include multiple countries and a rich preference structure. Our preference structure allows for fierce competition among firms from the same country and less intense competition among firms from different countries. We show a firm’s optimal markup after a tariff cut can rise or fall depending on the parameters of the preference structure and tariff-induced reallocation of market share among firms and across countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 贸易政策如何影响竞争？利用来自十一个低收入和中等收入国家的企业产品出口全样本数据，我们记录了贸易协定下的关税削减具有强烈的促进竞争效应——它们鼓励企业进入并降低出口商的（不含关税的）价格成本加成。这一发现，即加成随关税削减而下降，与标准寡头竞争贸易模型的核心预测相矛盾。我们将一个经典的寡头竞争国际定价模型扩展至包含多个国家和丰富的偏好结构。我们的偏好结构允许来自同一国家的企业之间竞争激烈，而来自不同国家的企业之间竞争不那么激烈。我们表明，企业在关税削减后的最优加成可能上升或下降，取决于偏好结构的参数以及关税引起的市场份额在企业间和国家间的重新分配。

articles.title_en: Trade invoicing currencies and exchange rate pass-through: The introduction of the euro as a natural experiment
articles.title_cn: 贸易计价货币与汇率传递：欧元引入作为自然实验
articles.abstract_en: A recent literature emphasizes the prominence of dominant currencies in international trade invoicing and the role of invoice currencies in the transmission of exchange rate shocks. In this paper, we examine the introduction of the euro as a once-in-a-century natural experiment that induced a substantial shifting in invoice currencies, allowing us to test existing theories. We use unique data on the invoice currencies of the universe of export and import transactions of Chilean firms trading with the Eurozone over the period 1997–2010. Before the euro, exports to the Eurozone were dominated by the US dollar, and euro legacy currencies were rarely used. The introduction of the euro led a substantial number of firms to switch their invoice currencies to euros, which eventually accounted for 40% of all transactions. We first study the determinants of the adoption of the euro in exports to the Eurozone, finding a key role for strategic complementarities and for the invoice currency of imported inputs. We then show how firms switching from dollars to euros faced a radical transformation of their exchange rate pass-through, in line with recent theories. While the literature has studied trade invoice currencies in settings in which these are very persistent firm-level choices, our findings validate the conjecture that large–scale policy changes can lead to changes in these choices, and simultaneous changes in exchange rate pass-through.
articles.abstract_cn: 近期文献强调主导货币在国际贸易计价中的突出地位以及计价货币在汇率冲击传导中的作用。本文考察了欧元引入这一百年一遇的自然实验，它引发了计价货币的显著转变，使我们得以检验现有理论。我们使用了1997-2010年间智利企业与欧元区进行的所有出口和进口交易的计价货币独特数据。在欧元引入之前，对欧元区的出口以美元为主导，欧元前身货币很少使用。欧元的引入导致大量企业将计价货币转换为欧元，最终欧元占所有交易的40%。我们首先研究了在向欧元区出口中采用欧元的决定因素，发现战略互补性和进口投入品计价货币起着关键作用。然后我们展示了从美元转向欧元的企业如何面临汇率传递的根本性转变，这与近期理论相符。虽然文献在研究贸易计价货币时通常将其视为企业层面的持久选择，但我们的发现验证了大规模政策变化可能导致这些选择发生变化，并同时引起汇率传递变化的猜想。

articles.title_en: Taking stock of trade policy uncertainty: Evidence from China’s pre-WTO accession
articles.title_cn: 贸易政策不确定性评估：来自中国入世前的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects on international trade from the annual tariff uncertainty about China’s MFN status renewal in the U.S. prior to joining the WTO. We have four main findings. First, in the monthly data, trade increases significantly in anticipation of uncertain future increases in tariffs and falls upon renewal. The peak-to-trough swings in trade are 62 percent of the possible tariff change. Second, the probability of a tariff increase was perceived to be relatively small, with an average annual probability of non-renewal of about 3.2 percent. Third, the anticipatory dynamics are entirely driven by the expected increase in tariffs, while uncertainty dampens them. We identify these effects using within-year variation in the risk of trade policy changes around the renewal vote and trade flows. We show that a (s̲,s¯) inventory model generates this behavior and that variation in the strength of the stockpiling in advance of the renewal decision is increasing in the storability of goods. Fourth, the costs associated with the trade policy induced stockpiling reduce entrants’ incentive to operate in a market with tariff uncertainty. Our results explain why trade may hold up in advance of a prospective policy change but may fall sharply even if expected tariff increases do not materialize.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了中国加入WTO之前，美国对中国最惠国待遇地位年度续期的不确定性对国际贸易的影响。我们有四个主要发现。首先，在月度数据中，贸易在预期未来关税可能上升时显著增加，而在续期后下降。贸易的峰谷波动幅度为可能关税变化的62%。其次，关税上升的概率被认为相对较小，年度不续期的平均概率约为3.2%。第三，预期动态完全由预期关税上升驱动，而不确定性则抑制了这种动态。我们利用续期投票前后贸易政策变化风险的年内变化和贸易流量来识别这些效应。我们证明了一个(s̲,s¯)库存模型能够产生这种行为，并且续期决定前囤积强度的变化随着商品的可储存性而增加。第四，贸易政策引发的囤积所带来的成本降低了进入者在存在关税不确定性的市场中运营的激励。我们的结果解释了为什么贸易在预期政策变化之前可能保持，但即使预期的关税上升没有实现，也可能急剧下降。

articles.title_en: International joint ventures and internal technology transfer vs. external technology spillovers: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 国际合资企业与内部技术转移及外部技术溢出：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the economics of international joint ventures using administrative data for China. We first show that foreign investors choose Chinese partners that are relatively large, productive, and more innovative to set up their joint venture. Using a difference-in-differences framework, we then provide evidence that joint ventures lead to domestic benefits in the form of productivity and technological spillovers to both the Chinese partners in joint ventures as well as other domestic Chinese firms. Exploiting the easing of joint venture requirements as China entered the WTO in the year 2001, we further show that intraindustry spillovers from joint ventures to other domestic firms increased in the wake of China’s WTO accession, consistent with gains from foreign technology rising due to enhanced commitment through the rules-based WTO system. Our results shed new light on the efficacy of FDI performance requirements as well as on claims regarding international technology transfer that underpinned the China–US trade war.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用中国的行政数据研究国际合资企业的经济学。我们首先表明，外国投资者选择规模相对较大、生产率较高且更具创新性的中国合作伙伴来设立合资企业。使用双重差分框架，我们随后提供证据表明，合资企业为国内带来了生产率和技术溢出方面的利益，既惠及合资企业中的中方合作伙伴，也惠及其他国内中国企业。利用中国于2001年加入世界贸易组织时合资企业要求的放宽，我们进一步表明，在中国加入世贸组织后，合资企业对其他国内企业的行业内溢出效应有所增加，这与通过基于规则的世界贸易组织体系增强承诺而导致的外国技术收益增加相一致。我们的结果为外商直接投资绩效要求的有效性以及支撑中美贸易战关于国际技术转移的主张提供了新的启示。

articles.title_en: A theory of capital flow retrenchment
articles.title_cn: 资本流动回撤理论
articles.abstract_en: During a downturn in the global financial cycle there is a simultaneous retrenchment in gross capital flows and a fall in risky asset prices. The global financial cycle is closely related to fluctuations in risk appetite. We develop a model that can simultaneously produce a fall in gross outflows, inflows, and asset prices following an increase in global risk aversion. There is heterogeneity across investors within a country in the willingness to hold risky assets and to hold foreign assets. The fall in the asset price after a rise in global risk aversion shifts the wealth distribution towards investors that are less willing to hold foreign assets. This leads a drop in gross flows. We calibrate the within country heterogeneity in the model to match heterogeneity observed in micro data of household portfolios. The retrenchment in the calibrated model is quantitatively similar to what we observe in the macro data.
articles.abstract_cn: 在全球金融周期下行期间，总资本流动同时出现回撤，风险资产价格下跌。全球金融周期与风险偏好的波动密切相关。我们开发了一个模型，该模型能够在全球风险厌恶情绪上升后同时产生总流出、流入和资产价格的下降。国内投资者在持有风险资产和外国资产的意愿上存在异质性。全球风险厌恶情绪上升后资产价格的下跌将财富分配转向那些不太愿意持有外国资产的投资者。这导致总流动下降。我们在模型中校准了国内异质性，以匹配家庭投资组合微观数据中观察到的异质性。校准模型中的回撤在数量上与我们在宏观数据中观察到的相似。

articles.title_en: Foundation of the small open economy model with product differentiation
articles.title_cn: 产品差异化小型开放经济模型的基础
articles.abstract_en: We derive a small open economy (SOE) as the limit of an economy as the number or size of its trading partners goes to infinity and trade costs also go to infinity. We obtain this limit in the Armington, Eaton–Kortum, Krugman, and Melitz models. In all cases, the trade of the SOE with the foreign countries approaches a finite limit, and the domestic expenditure share for the SOE approaches a limit that is not zero or unity. The foreign countries can be either infinitely many SOEs, or alternatively, one or many large countries with domestic expenditure shares that approach unity. We illustrate the usefulness of this framework by obtaining a formula for the optimal tariff in the SOE – depending on the elasticity of domestic wages with respect to the tariff – that is consistent with all models.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将小型开放经济（SOE）推导为当贸易伙伴数量或规模趋于无穷大且贸易成本也趋于无穷大时经济的极限。我们在Armington、Eaton–Kortum、Krugman和Melitz模型中获得了这一极限。在所有情况下，SOE与外国国家的贸易趋近于有限极限，且SOE的国内支出份额趋近于既非零也非一的极限。外国国家可以是无限多个SOE，或者也可以是一个或多个国内支出份额趋近于一的大国。我们通过获得SOE中最优关税的公式——该公式取决于国内工资对关税的弹性——来说明这一框架的有用性，且该公式与所有模型一致。

articles.title_en: International transmission of the U.S. dollar liquidity shock: The channel of FX borrowing and lending
articles.title_cn: 美元流动性冲击的国际传导：外汇借贷渠道
articles.abstract_en: Access to foreign exchange (FX) liquidity is crucial to the growth and stability of emerging market economies. We examine the impact of U.S. dollar liquidity shocks on firm investments in Korea by constructing a dataset that merges four distinct micro-level data spanning ten years from 2006 to 2015. We trace the path of FX liquidity from the international financial market to Korean banks and subsequently to listed firms. During international liquidity shocks, banks borrow less FX but pay higher interest rates. Weak banks, whose FX borrowing rates are sensitive to these shocks, reduce their FX credit supply to firms. Among the FX loan-reliant firms that are highly productive, those borrowing from weak banks reduce their investments. This channel of FX borrowing and lending accounts for 19% of the decline in the investment of listed firms during the peak of the Global Financial Crisis.
articles.abstract_cn: 获取外汇流动性对新兴市场经济体的增长和稳定至关重要。我们通过构建一个数据集来研究美元流动性冲击对韩国企业投资的影响，该数据集合并了从2006年到2015年十年间四个不同的微观层面数据。我们追踪了外汇流动性从国际金融市场到韩国银行，再到上市公司的路径。在国际流动性冲击期间，银行减少外汇借款但支付更高的利率。弱银行，其外汇借款利率对这些冲击敏感，减少了对企业的外汇信贷供应。在依赖外汇贷款且生产率高的企业中，那些从弱银行借款的企业减少了投资。在全球金融危机高峰期，这种外汇借贷渠道占上市公司投资下降的19%。

articles.title_en: Sovereign debt and credit default swaps
articles.title_cn: 主权债务与信用违约互换
articles.abstract_en: How do credit default swaps (CDS) affect sovereign debt markets? We analyze how liquidity, exposure to default risk, and regulation affect the answer to this question using a sovereign debt model where investors trade bonds and CDS over the counter via directed search. Restricting portfolios can improve bond prices and bond-market activity, but the net effect depends on relative frictions in bond and CDS markets, the exposure of investors, and how the sovereign responds to the policy. Our novel identification strategy exploits confidential microdata to quantify trading frictions and the exposure distribution. The calibrated model generates realistic CDS-bond basis deviations, bid–ask spreads, and CDS volumes and positions. Our baseline specification predicts trading frictions and an inability to short sell bonds significantly improves sovereign debt prices, but policies that restrict CDS trading have small effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 信用违约互换（CDS）如何影响主权债务市场？我们通过一个主权债务模型来分析流动性、违约风险敞口和监管如何影响这一问题的答案，在该模型中，投资者通过定向搜索在场外交易债券和CDS。限制投资组合可以改善债券价格和债券市场活动，但净效应取决于债券和CDS市场的相对摩擦、投资者的敞口以及主权国家对政策的反应。我们的新颖识别策略利用机密微观数据来量化交易摩擦和敞口分布。校准模型产生了现实的CDS-债券基差偏差、买卖价差以及CDS交易量和持仓量。我们的基准设定预测，交易摩擦和无法卖空债券显著提高了主权债务价格，但限制CDS交易的政策影响较小。

articles.title_en: Buying lottery tickets for foreign workers: Lost quota rents induced by H-1B policy
articles.title_cn: 为外国工人购买彩票：H-1B政策导致的配额租金损失
articles.abstract_en: The H-1B program allows firms in the United States to temporarily hire high-skilled foreign citizens. The government restricts inflows of new H-1B workers and therefore creates potential rents typical of a quota. Importantly, however, the US allocates H-1B status by random lottery. We develop a theoretical model demonstrating that this lottery creates a negative externality that destroys quota rents by incentivizing firms to search for more workers than can actually be hired. Some firms specialize in hiring foreign labor and contracting out those workers’ services to third-party sites. These outsourcing firms exacerbate the search externality. Numerical exercises suggest that these processes result in an annual economic loss exceeding $10,000 per new H-1B worker hired relative to what would occur in the absence of lottery allocation.
articles.abstract_cn: H-1B计划允许美国公司临时雇用高技能外国公民。政府限制新H-1B工人的流入，因此产生了典型的配额租金。然而，重要的是，美国通过随机抽签分配H-1B身份。我们开发了一个理论模型，表明这种抽签产生了一种负外部性，通过激励公司寻找比实际可雇用更多的工人，从而破坏了配额租金。一些公司专门雇用外国劳动力，并将这些工人的服务外包给第三方站点。这些外包公司加剧了搜索外部性。数值模拟表明，相对于没有抽签分配的情况，这些过程导致每个新雇用的H-1B工人每年经济损失超过$10,000。

articles.title_en: Are trade wars class wars? The importance of trade-induced horizontal inequality
articles.title_cn: 贸易战是阶级战争吗？贸易引发的水平不平等的重要性
articles.abstract_en: What is the nature of the distributional effects of trade? This paper demonstrates conceptually and empirically the importance of “trade-induced horizontal inequality,” i.e. inequality that occurs among workers with the same level of earnings before the trade shock. This type of inequality does not affect the income distribution but generates winners and losers at all income levels. To quantify the horizontal inequality and changes in the income distribution induced by trade in a data-driven way, we develop a characterization of the welfare impacts, governed by simple and intuitive statistics of labor market and consumption exposure to trade. In the U.S., we find substantial heterogeneity in exposure and thus in the welfare effects of trade shocks across workers. Over 99% of the variance of welfare changes from trade shocks arises within income deciles. These findings run against a popular narrative that “trade wars are class wars.”
articles.abstract_cn: 贸易的分配效应的本质是什么？本文在概念上和实证上证明了“贸易引发的水平不平等”的重要性，即贸易冲击前收入水平相同的工人之间出现的不平等。这种类型的不平等不影响收入分配，但在所有收入水平上都会产生赢家和输家。为了以数据驱动的方式量化贸易引发的水平不平等和收入分配的变化，我们开发了福利影响的特征化，由劳动力市场和消费对贸易暴露的简单直观的统计量所支配。在美国，我们发现工人之间在暴露程度以及因此贸易冲击的福利效应上存在显著的异质性。贸易冲击福利变化方差的超过99%发生在收入十分位组内。这些发现与“贸易战是阶级战争”的流行说法相悖。
